contactNamePolicy: Complete source Name in lastname and re_salesforcename; firstname null. Never split the source name.
importScope: Preserve valid source masters regardless of active flags; dropdown eligibility is separate.
equipmentRelationshipPolicy: Exact Account.Id only. Preserve original number strings; quarantine missing parent IDs and duplicate equipment numbers.
existingNativeRecordPolicy: Never attach or overwrite a native record based only on account number or email. Report collisions for reconciliation.
contactIdentityPolicy: Use the Salesforce Contact ID as identity. Preserve distinct source contacts that share an email; reject an email match only when the existing Contact has no source ID.
